    model,
    tokenizer,
    prompt: str,
    max_new_tokens: int,
    do_sample: bool,
    temperature: float,
    top_p: float,
) -> str:

    inputs = {k: v.to(model_device(model)) for k, v in inputs.items()}
    generation_kwargs = {
        "max_new_tokens": max_new_tokens,
        "do_sample": do_sample,
        "temperature": temperature if do_sample else None,
        "top_p": top_p if do_sample else None,
        "pad_token_id": tokenizer.pad_token_id,
        "eos_token_id": tokenizer.eos_token_id,
    }
    generation_kwargs = {k: v for k, v in generation_kwargs.items() if v is not None}
    start = time.time()
    with torch.no_grad():
        output = model.generate(**inputs, **generation_kwargs)
    elapsed = time.time() - start
    log(
        f"[generate] prompt_tokens={inputs['input_ids'].shape[1]} "
        f"new_tokens<={max_new_tokens} elapsed={elapsed:.2f}s device={model_device(model)}"
    )
    new_tokens = output[0][inputs["input_ids"].shape[1] :]
    text = tokenizer.decode(new_tokens, skip_special_tokens=False)
    return extract_generated_code(text)

def aggregate(results: list[TaskResult]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    grouped: dict[str, list[TaskResult]] = {}
    for result in results:
        grouped.setdefault(result.strategy, []).append(result)

    summary: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for strategy, items in grouped.items():
        total = len(items)
        syntax = sum(1 for x in items if x.syntax_ok)
        accepted = sum(1 for x in items if x.accepted)
        public_pass = sum(1 for x in items if x.public_pass)
        guard_pass = sum(1 for x in items if x.guard_pass)
        oracle_pass = sum(1 for x in items if x.oracle_pass)
        hallucinations = total - oracle_pass
        summary.append(
            {
                "strategy": strategy,
                "total_tasks": total,
                "syntax_valid_rate": round(100.0 * syntax / total, 2),
                "accepted_rate": round(100.0 * accepted / total, 2),
                "public_test_pass_rate": round(100.0 * public_pass / total, 2),
                "guard_pass_rate": round(100.0 * guard_pass / total, 2),
                "semantic_preservation_rate": round(100.0 * oracle_pass / total, 2),
                "hallucination_rate": round(100.0 * hallucinations / total, 2),
                "mean_iterations": round(mean([x.iterations for x in items]), 2),
            }
        )
    return sorted(summary, key=lambda x: x["strategy"])

original_code:
def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate baseline GPT-2 refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--do-sample", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.95)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit-tasks", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tasks = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "test_tasks.jsonl")
    if args.limit_tasks > 0:
        tasks = tasks[: args.limit_tasks]

    log(f"[setup] loaded {len(tasks)} test tasks from {args.benchmark_dir / 'test_tasks.jsonl'}")
    log(
        f"[setup] max_new_tokens={args.max_new_tokens} max_iterations={args.max_iterations} "
        f"do_sample={args.do_sample} requested_device={args.device}"
    )
    model, tokenizer = load_model(args.model_dir, args.device)

    args.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results: list[TaskResult] = []
    for idx, task in enumerate(tasks, start=1):
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] baseline -> {task['task_id']} ({task['family']})")
        results.append(
            run_baseline(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
            )
        )
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] refactorguard_sc -> {task['task_id']}")
        results.append(
            run_refactorguard(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
                max_iterations=args.max_iterations,
            )
        )

    summary = aggregate(results)

    save_predictions(args.report_dir / "predictions.jsonl", results)
    save_summary_json(args.report_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    save_summary_csv(args.report_dir / "summary.csv", summary)
    save_report(args.report_dir / "report.md", summary, test_size=len(tasks))
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="hallucination_rate",
        ylabel="Hallucination rate (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "hallucination_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 hallucination rate: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="semantic_preservation_rate",
        ylabel="Semantic preservation (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "semantic_preservation_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 semantic preservation: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )

    log(f"[done] report artifacts written to {args.report_dir}")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate baseline GPT-2 refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--do-sample", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.95)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit-tasks", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tasks = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "test_tasks.jsonl")
    if args.limit_tasks > 0:
        tasks = tasks[: args.limit_tasks]

    log(f"[setup] loaded {len(tasks)} test tasks from {args.benchmark_dir / 'test_tasks.jsonl'}")
    log(
        f"[setup] max_new_tokens={args.max_new_tokens} max_iterations={args.max_iterations} "
        f"do_sample={args.do_sample} requested_device={args.device}"
    )
    model, tokenizer = load_model(args.model_dir, args.device)

    args.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results: list[TaskResult] = []
    for idx, task in enumerate(tasks, start=1):
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] baseline -> {task['task_id']} ({task['family']})")
        results.append(
            run_baseline(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
            )
        )
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] refactorguard_sc -> {task['task_id']}")
        results.append(
            run_refactorguard(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
                max_iterations=args.max_iterations,
            )
        )

    summary = aggregate(results)

    save_predictions(args.report_dir / "predictions.jsonl", results)
    save_summary_json(args.report_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    save_summary_csv(args.report_dir / "summary.csv", summary)
    save_report(args.report_dir / "report.md", summary, test_size=len(tasks))
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="hallucination_rate",
        ylabel="Hallucination rate (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "hallucination_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 hallucination rate: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="semantic_preservation_rate",
        ylabel="Semantic preservation (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "semantic_preservation_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 semantic preservation: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )

    log(f"[done] report artifacts written to {args.report_dir}")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate baseline GPT-2 refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--do-sample", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.95)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit-tasks", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tasks = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "test_tasks.jsonl")
    if args.limit_tasks > 0:
        tasks = tasks[: args.limit_tasks]

    log(f"[setup] loaded {len(tasks)} test tasks from {args.benchmark_dir / 'test_tasks.jsonl'}")
    log(
        f"[setup] max_new_tokens={args.max_new_tokens} max_iterations={args.max_iterations} "
        f"do_sample={args.do_sample} requested_device={args.device}"
    )
    model, tokenizer = load_model(args.model_dir, args.device)

    args.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results: list[TaskResult] = []
    for idx, task in enumerate(tasks, start=1):
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] baseline -> {task['task_id']} ({task['family']})")
        results.append(
            run_baseline(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
            )
        )
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] refactorguard_sc -> {task['task_id']}")
        results.append(
            run_refactorguard(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
                max_iterations=args.max_iterations,
            )
        )

    summary = aggregate(results)

    save_predictions(args.report_dir / "predictions.jsonl", results)
    save_summary_json(args.report_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    save_summary_csv(args.report_dir / "summary.csv", summary)
    save_report(args.report_dir / "report.md", summary, test_size=len(tasks))
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="hallucination_rate",
        ylabel="Hallucination rate (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "hallucination_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 hallucination rate: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="semantic_preservation_rate",
        ylabel="Semantic preservation (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "semantic_preservation_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 semantic preservation: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )

    log(f"[done] report artifacts written to {args.report_dir}")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate baseline GPT-2 refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--do-sample", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.95)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit-tasks", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tasks = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "test_tasks.jsonl")
    if args.limit_tasks > 0:
        tasks = tasks[: args.limit_tasks]

    log(f"[setup] loaded {len(tasks)} test tasks from {args.benchmark_dir / 'test_tasks.jsonl'}")
    log(
        f"[setup] max_new_tokens={args.max_new_tokens} max_iterations={args.max_iterations} "
        f"do_sample={args.do_sample} requested_device={args.device}"
    )
    model, tokenizer = load_model(args.model_dir, args.device)

    args.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results: list[TaskResult] = []
    for idx, task in enumerate(tasks, start=1):
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] baseline -> {task['task_id']} ({task['family']})")
        results.append(
            run_baseline(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
            )
        )
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] refactorguard_sc -> {task['task_id']}")
        results.append(
            run_refactorguard(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
                max_iterations=args.max_iterations,
            )
        )

    summary = aggregate(results)

    save_predictions(args.report_dir / "predictions.jsonl", results)
    save_summary_json(args.report_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    save_summary_csv(args.report_dir / "summary.csv", summary)
    save_report(args.report_dir / "report.md", summary, test_size=len(tasks))
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="hallucination_rate",
        ylabel="Hallucination rate (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "hallucination_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 hallucination rate: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="semantic_preservation_rate",
        ylabel="Semantic preservation (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "semantic_preservation_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 semantic preservation: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )

    log(f"[done] report artifacts written to {args.report_dir}")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate baseline GPT-2 refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--do-sample", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.95)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit-tasks", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tasks = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "test_tasks.jsonl")
    if args.limit_tasks > 0:
        tasks = tasks[: args.limit_tasks]

    log(f"[setup] loaded {len(tasks)} test tasks from {args.benchmark_dir / 'test_tasks.jsonl'}")
    log(
        f"[setup] max_new_tokens={args.max_new_tokens} max_iterations={args.max_iterations} "
        f"do_sample={args.do_sample} requested_device={args.device}"
    )
    model, tokenizer = load_model(args.model_dir, args.device)

    args.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results: list[TaskResult] = []
    for idx, task in enumerate(tasks, start=1):
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] baseline -> {task['task_id']} ({task['family']})")
        results.append(
            run_baseline(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
            )
        )
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] refactorguard_sc -> {task['task_id']}")
        results.append(
            run_refactorguard(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
                max_iterations=args.max_iterations,
            )
        )

    summary = aggregate(results)

    save_predictions(args.report_dir / "predictions.jsonl", results)
    save_summary_json(args.report_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    save_summary_csv(args.report_dir / "summary.csv", summary)
    save_report(args.report_dir / "report.md", summary, test_size=len(tasks))
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="hallucination_rate",
        ylabel="Hallucination rate (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "hallucination_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 hallucination rate: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="semantic_preservation_rate",
        ylabel="Semantic preservation (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "semantic_preservation_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 semantic preservation: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )

    log(f"[done] report artifacts written to {args.report_dir}")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate baseline GPT-2 refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--do-sample", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.95)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit-tasks", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tasks = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "test_tasks.jsonl")
    if args.limit_tasks > 0:
        tasks = tasks[: args.limit_tasks]

    log(f"[setup] loaded {len(tasks)} test tasks from {args.benchmark_dir / 'test_tasks.jsonl'}")
    log(
        f"[setup] max_new_tokens={args.max_new_tokens} max_iterations={args.max_iterations} "
        f"do_sample={args.do_sample} requested_device={args.device}"
    )
    model, tokenizer = load_model(args.model_dir, args.device)

    args.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results: list[TaskResult] = []
    for idx, task in enumerate(tasks, start=1):
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] baseline -> {task['task_id']} ({task['family']})")
        results.append(
            run_baseline(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
            )
        )
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] refactorguard_sc -> {task['task_id']}")
        results.append(
            run_refactorguard(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
                max_iterations=args.max_iterations,
            )
        )

    summary = aggregate(results)

    save_predictions(args.report_dir / "predictions.jsonl", results)
    save_summary_json(args.report_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    save_summary_csv(args.report_dir / "summary.csv", summary)
    save_report(args.report_dir / "report.md", summary, test_size=len(tasks))
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="hallucination_rate",
        ylabel="Hallucination rate (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "hallucination_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 hallucination rate: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="semantic_preservation_rate",
        ylabel="Semantic preservation (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "semantic_preservation_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 semantic preservation: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )

    log(f"[done] report artifacts written to {args.report_dir}")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate baseline GPT-2 refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--do-sample", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.95)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit-tasks", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tasks = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "test_tasks.jsonl")
    if args.limit_tasks > 0:
        tasks = tasks[: args.limit_tasks]

    log(f"[setup] loaded {len(tasks)} test tasks from {args.benchmark_dir / 'test_tasks.jsonl'}")
    log(
        f"[setup] max_new_tokens={args.max_new_tokens} max_iterations={args.max_iterations} "
        f"do_sample={args.do_sample} requested_device={args.device}"
    )
    model, tokenizer = load_model(args.model_dir, args.device)

    args.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results: list[TaskResult] = []
    for idx, task in enumerate(tasks, start=1):
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] baseline -> {task['task_id']} ({task['family']})")
        results.append(
            run_baseline(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
            )
        )
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] refactorguard_sc -> {task['task_id']}")
        results.append(
            run_refactorguard(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
                max_iterations=args.max_iterations,
            )
        )

    summary = aggregate(results)

    save_predictions(args.report_dir / "predictions.jsonl", results)
    save_summary_json(args.report_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    save_summary_csv(args.report_dir / "summary.csv", summary)
    save_report(args.report_dir / "report.md", summary, test_size=len(tasks))
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="hallucination_rate",
        ylabel="Hallucination rate (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "hallucination_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 hallucination rate: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="semantic_preservation_rate",
        ylabel="Semantic preservation (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "semantic_preservation_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 semantic preservation: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )

    log(f"[done] report artifacts written to {args.report_dir}")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate baseline GPT-2 refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--do-sample", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.95)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit-tasks", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tasks = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "test_tasks.jsonl")
    if args.limit_tasks > 0:
        tasks = tasks[: args.limit_tasks]

    log(f"[setup] loaded {len(tasks)} test tasks from {args.benchmark_dir / 'test_tasks.jsonl'}")
    log(
        f"[setup] max_new_tokens={args.max_new_tokens} max_iterations={args.max_iterations} "
        f"do_sample={args.do_sample} requested_device={args.device}"
    )
    model, tokenizer = load_model(args.model_dir, args.device)

    args.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results: list[TaskResult] = []
    for idx, task in enumerate(tasks, start=1):
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] baseline -> {task['task_id']} ({task['family']})")
        results.append(
            run_baseline(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
            )
        )
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] refactorguard_sc -> {task['task_id']}")
        results.append(
            run_refactorguard(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
                max_iterations=args.max_iterations,
            )
        )

    summary = aggregate(results)

    save_predictions(args.report_dir / "predictions.jsonl", results)
    save_summary_json(args.report_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    save_summary_csv(args.report_dir / "summary.csv", summary)
    save_report(args.report_dir / "report.md", summary, test_size=len(tasks))
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="hallucination_rate",
        ylabel="Hallucination rate (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "hallucination_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 hallucination rate: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="semantic_preservation_rate",
        ylabel="Semantic preservation (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "semantic_preservation_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 semantic preservation: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )

    log(f"[done] report artifacts written to {args.report_dir}")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate baseline GPT-2 refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--do-sample", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.95)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit-tasks", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tasks = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "test_tasks.jsonl")
    if args.limit_tasks > 0:
        tasks = tasks[: args.limit_tasks]

    log(f"[setup] loaded {len(tasks)} test tasks from {args.benchmark_dir / 'test_tasks.jsonl'}")
    log(
        f"[setup] max_new_tokens={args.max_new_tokens} max_iterations={args.max_iterations} "
        f"do_sample={args.do_sample} requested_device={args.device}"
    )
    model, tokenizer = load_model(args.model_dir, args.device)

    args.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results: list[TaskResult] = []
    for idx, task in enumerate(tasks, start=1):
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] baseline -> {task['task_id']} ({task['family']})")
        results.append(
            run_baseline(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
            )
        )
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] refactorguard_sc -> {task['task_id']}")
        results.append(
            run_refactorguard(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
                max_iterations=args.max_iterations,
            )
        )

    summary = aggregate(results)

    save_predictions(args.report_dir / "predictions.jsonl", results)
    save_summary_json(args.report_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    save_summary_csv(args.report_dir / "summary.csv", summary)
    save_report(args.report_dir / "report.md", summary, test_size=len(tasks))
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="hallucination_rate",
        ylabel="Hallucination rate (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "hallucination_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 hallucination rate: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="semantic_preservation_rate",
        ylabel="Semantic preservation (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "semantic_preservation_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 semantic preservation: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )

    log(f"[done] report artifacts written to {args.report_dir}")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate baseline GPT-2 refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--do-sample", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.95)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit-tasks", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tasks = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "test_tasks.jsonl")
    if args.limit_tasks > 0:
        tasks = tasks[: args.limit_tasks]

    log(f"[setup] loaded {len(tasks)} test tasks from {args.benchmark_dir / 'test_tasks.jsonl'}")
    log(
        f"[setup] max_new_tokens={args.max_new_tokens} max_iterations={args.max_iterations} "
        f"do_sample={args.do_sample} requested_device={args.device}"
    )
    model, tokenizer = load_model(args.model_dir, args.device)

    args.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results: list[TaskResult] = []
    for idx, task in enumerate(tasks, start=1):
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] baseline -> {task['task_id']} ({task['family']})")
        results.append(
            run_baseline(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
            )
        )
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] refactorguard_sc -> {task['task_id']}")
        results.append(
            run_refactorguard(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
                max_iterations=args.max_iterations,
            )
        )

    summary = aggregate(results)

    save_predictions(args.report_dir / "predictions.jsonl", results)
    save_summary_json(args.report_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    save_summary_csv(args.report_dir / "summary.csv", summary)
    save_report(args.report_dir / "report.md", summary, test_size=len(tasks))
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="hallucination_rate",
        ylabel="Hallucination rate (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "hallucination_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 hallucination rate: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="semantic_preservation_rate",
        ylabel="Semantic preservation (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "semantic_preservation_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 semantic preservation: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )

    log(f"[done] report artifacts written to {args.report_dir}")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate baseline GPT-2 refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--do-sample", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.95)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit-tasks", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tasks = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "test_tasks.jsonl")
    if args.limit_tasks > 0:
        tasks = tasks[: args.limit_tasks]

    log(f"[setup] loaded {len(tasks)} test tasks from {args.benchmark_dir / 'test_tasks.jsonl'}")
    log(
        f"[setup] max_new_tokens={args.max_new_tokens} max_iterations={args.max_iterations} "
        f"do_sample={args.do_sample} requested_device={args.device}"
    )
    model, tokenizer = load_model(args.model_dir, args.device)

    args.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results: list[TaskResult] = []
    for idx, task in enumerate(tasks, start=1):
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] baseline -> {task['task_id']} ({task['family']})")
        results.append(
            run_baseline(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
            )
        )
        log(f"[task {idx}/{len(tasks)}] refactorguard_sc -> {task['task_id']}")
        results.append(
            run_refactorguard(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                task=task,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=args.do_sample,
                temperature=args.temperature,
                top_p=args.top_p,
                max_iterations=args.max_iterations,
            )
        )

    summary = aggregate(results)

    save_predictions(args.report_dir / "predictions.jsonl", results)
    save_summary_json(args.report_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    save_summary_csv(args.report_dir / "summary.csv", summary)
    save_report(args.report_dir / "report.md", summary, test_size=len(tasks))
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="hallucination_rate",
        ylabel="Hallucination rate (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "hallucination_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 hallucination rate: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )
    plot_metric(
        summary,
        metric="semantic_preservation_rate",
        ylabel="Semantic preservation (%)",
        output_path=args.report_dir / "semantic_preservation_rate.png",
        title="GPT-2 semantic preservation: ordinary refactoring vs RefactorGuard-SC",
    )

    log(f"[done] report artifacts written to {args.report_dir}")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

    print("report:", report_dir)

    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=3)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    benchmark_dir = args.work_dir / "benchmark"
    model_dir = args.work_dir / "model"
    report_dir = args.work_dir / "report"

    args.work_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            str(root / "benchmark.py"),
            "--output-dir",
            str(benchmark_dir),
            "--train-size",
            str(args.train_size),
            "--val-size",
            str(args.val_size),
            "--test-size",
            str(args.test_size),
            "--seed",
            str(args.seed),
        ]
    )

    run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            str(root / "train_gpt2.py"),
            "--benchmark-dir",
            str(benchmark_dir),
            "--output-dir",
            str(model_dir),
            "--model-name",
            args.model_name,
            "--epochs",
            str(args.epochs),
            "--max-length",
            str(args.max_length),
            "--seed",
            str(args.seed),
        ]
    )

    run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            str(root / "evaluate_gpt2.py"),
            "--benchmark-dir",
            str(benchmark_dir),
            "--model-dir",
            str(model_dir),
            "--report-dir",
            str(report_dir),
            "--max-new-tokens",
            str(args.max_new_tokens),
            "--max-iterations",
            str(args.max_iterations),
        ]
    )

    print("\nArtifacts:")
    print("benchmark:", benchmark_dir)
    print("model:", model_dir)
    print("report:", report_dir)

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Fine-tune GPT-2 for synthetic refactoring + repair tasks.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-name", type=str, default="gpt2")
    parser.add_argument("--max-length", type=int, default=768)
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=float, default=3.0)
    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=5e-5)
    parser.add_argument("--train-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--gradient-accumulation-steps", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--weight-decay", type=float, default=0.01)
    parser.add_argument("--warmup-ratio", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument("--logging-steps", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--save-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    train_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "train_sft.jsonl")
    val_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "val_sft.jsonl")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    train_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(train_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    val_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(val_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    collator = PromptCompletionCollator(tokenizer)

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    model.config.pad_token_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    device_flags = resolve_device_flags()

    training_args = TrainingArguments(
        output_dir=str(args.output_dir),
        num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
        learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
        per_device_train_batch_size=args.train_batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.eval_batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        weight_decay=args.weight_decay,
        warmup_ratio=args.warmup_ratio,
        logging_steps=args.logging_steps,
        save_steps=args.save_steps,
        eval_steps=args.eval_steps,
        eval_strategy="steps",
        save_strategy="steps",
        load_best_model_at_end=True,
        metric_for_best_model="eval_loss",
        greater_is_better=False,
        remove_unused_columns=False,
        report_to=[],
        seed=args.seed,
        fp16=device_flags["fp16"],
        bf16=device_flags["bf16"],
    )

    trainer = Trainer(
        model=model,
        args=training_args,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=val_dataset,
        data_collator=collator,
    )

    trainer.train()
    trainer.save_model(args.output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)

    metadata = {
        "model_name": args.model_name,
        "max_length": args.max_length,
        "epochs": args.epochs,
        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
        "gradient_accumulation_steps": args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        "train_examples": len(train_dataset),
        "val_examples": len(val_dataset),
    }
    (args.output_dir / "training_metadata.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Fine-tune GPT-2 for synthetic refactoring + repair tasks.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-name", type=str, default="gpt2")
    parser.add_argument("--max-length", type=int, default=768)
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=float, default=3.0)
    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=5e-5)
    parser.add_argument("--train-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--gradient-accumulation-steps", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--weight-decay", type=float, default=0.01)
    parser.add_argument("--warmup-ratio", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument("--logging-steps", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--save-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    train_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "train_sft.jsonl")
    val_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "val_sft.jsonl")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    train_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(train_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    val_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(val_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    collator = PromptCompletionCollator(tokenizer)

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    model.config.pad_token_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    device_flags = resolve_device_flags()

    training_args = TrainingArguments(
        output_dir=str(args.output_dir),
        num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
        learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
        per_device_train_batch_size=args.train_batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.eval_batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        weight_decay=args.weight_decay,
        warmup_ratio=args.warmup_ratio,
        logging_steps=args.logging_steps,
        save_steps=args.save_steps,
        eval_steps=args.eval_steps,
        eval_strategy="steps",
        save_strategy="steps",
        load_best_model_at_end=True,
        metric_for_best_model="eval_loss",
        greater_is_better=False,
        remove_unused_columns=False,
        report_to=[],
        seed=args.seed,
        fp16=device_flags["fp16"],
        bf16=device_flags["bf16"],
    )

    trainer = Trainer(
        model=model,
        args=training_args,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=val_dataset,
        data_collator=collator,
    )

    trainer.train()
    trainer.save_model(args.output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)

    metadata = {
        "model_name": args.model_name,
        "max_length": args.max_length,
        "epochs": args.epochs,
        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
        "gradient_accumulation_steps": args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        "train_examples": len(train_dataset),
        "val_examples": len(val_dataset),
    }
    (args.output_dir / "training_metadata.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Fine-tune GPT-2 for synthetic refactoring + repair tasks.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-name", type=str, default="gpt2")
    parser.add_argument("--max-length", type=int, default=768)
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=float, default=3.0)
    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=5e-5)
    parser.add_argument("--train-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--gradient-accumulation-steps", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--weight-decay", type=float, default=0.01)
    parser.add_argument("--warmup-ratio", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument("--logging-steps", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--save-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    train_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "train_sft.jsonl")
    val_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "val_sft.jsonl")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    train_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(train_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    val_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(val_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    collator = PromptCompletionCollator(tokenizer)

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    model.config.pad_token_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    device_flags = resolve_device_flags()

    training_args = TrainingArguments(
        output_dir=str(args.output_dir),
        num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
        learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
        per_device_train_batch_size=args.train_batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.eval_batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        weight_decay=args.weight_decay,
        warmup_ratio=args.warmup_ratio,
        logging_steps=args.logging_steps,
        save_steps=args.save_steps,
        eval_steps=args.eval_steps,
        eval_strategy="steps",
        save_strategy="steps",
        load_best_model_at_end=True,
        metric_for_best_model="eval_loss",
        greater_is_better=False,
        remove_unused_columns=False,
        report_to=[],
        seed=args.seed,
        fp16=device_flags["fp16"],
        bf16=device_flags["bf16"],
    )

    trainer = Trainer(
        model=model,
        args=training_args,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=val_dataset,
        data_collator=collator,
    )

    trainer.train()
    trainer.save_model(args.output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)

    metadata = {
        "model_name": args.model_name,
        "max_length": args.max_length,
        "epochs": args.epochs,
        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
        "gradient_accumulation_steps": args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        "train_examples": len(train_dataset),
        "val_examples": len(val_dataset),
    }
    (args.output_dir / "training_metadata.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

        model=model,

        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=val_dataset,
        data_collator=collator,

    trainer.train()
    trainer.save_model(args.output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)

    metadata = {
        "model_name": args.model_name,
        "max_length": args.max_length,
        "epochs": args.epochs,
        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
        "gradient_accumulation_steps": args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        "train_examples": len(train_dataset),
        "val_examples": len(val_dataset),
    }
    (args.output_dir / "training_metadata.json").write_text(

        encoding="utf-8",

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Fine-tune GPT-2 for synthetic refactoring + repair tasks.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-name", type=str, default="gpt2")
    parser.add_argument("--max-length", type=int, default=768)
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=float, default=3.0)
    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=5e-5)
    parser.add_argument("--train-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--gradient-accumulation-steps", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--weight-decay", type=float, default=0.01)
    parser.add_argument("--warmup-ratio", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument("--logging-steps", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--save-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    train_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "train_sft.jsonl")
    val_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "val_sft.jsonl")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    train_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(train_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    val_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(val_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    collator = PromptCompletionCollator(tokenizer)

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    model.config.pad_token_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    device_flags = resolve_device_flags()

    training_args = TrainingArguments(
        output_dir=str(args.output_dir),
        num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
        learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
        per_device_train_batch_size=args.train_batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.eval_batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        weight_decay=args.weight_decay,
        warmup_ratio=args.warmup_ratio,
        logging_steps=args.logging_steps,
        save_steps=args.save_steps,
        eval_steps=args.eval_steps,
        eval_strategy="steps",
        save_strategy="steps",
        load_best_model_at_end=True,
        metric_for_best_model="eval_loss",
        greater_is_better=False,
        remove_unused_columns=False,
        report_to=[],
        seed=args.seed,
        fp16=device_flags["fp16"],
        bf16=device_flags["bf16"],
    )

    trainer = Trainer(
        model=model,
        args=training_args,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=val_dataset,
        data_collator=collator,
    )

    trainer.train()
    trainer.save_model(args.output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)

    metadata = {
        "model_name": args.model_name,
        "max_length": args.max_length,
        "epochs": args.epochs,
        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
        "gradient_accumulation_steps": args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        "train_examples": len(train_dataset),
        "val_examples": len(val_dataset),
    }
    (args.output_dir / "training_metadata.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-name", type=str, default="gpt2")
    parser.add_argument("--max-length", type=int, default=768)
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=float, default=3.0)
    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=5e-5)
    parser.add_argument("--train-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--gradient-accumulation-steps", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--weight-decay", type=float, default=0.01)
    parser.add_argument("--warmup-ratio", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument("--logging-steps", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--save-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    train_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "train_sft.jsonl")
    val_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "val_sft.jsonl")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    train_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(train_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    val_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(val_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    collator = PromptCompletionCollator(tokenizer)

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    model.config.pad_token_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    device_flags = resolve_device_flags()

    training_args = TrainingArguments(
        output_dir=str(args.output_dir),
        num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
        learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
        per_device_train_batch_size=args.train_batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.eval_batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        weight_decay=args.weight_decay,
        warmup_ratio=args.warmup_ratio,
        logging_steps=args.logging_steps,
        save_steps=args.save_steps,
        eval_steps=args.eval_steps,
        eval_strategy="steps",
        save_strategy="steps",
        load_best_model_at_end=True,
        metric_for_best_model="eval_loss",
        greater_is_better=False,
        remove_unused_columns=False,
        report_to=[],
        seed=args.seed,
        fp16=device_flags["fp16"],
        bf16=device_flags["bf16"],
    )

    trainer = Trainer(
        model=model,
        args=training_args,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=val_dataset,
        data_collator=collator,
    )

    trainer.train()
    trainer.save_model(args.output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)

    metadata = {
        "model_name": args.model_name,
        "max_length": args.max_length,
        "epochs": args.epochs,
        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
        "gradient_accumulation_steps": args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        "train_examples": len(train_dataset),
        "val_examples": len(val_dataset),
    }
    (args.output_dir / "training_metadata.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Fine-tune GPT-2 for synthetic refactoring + repair tasks.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-name", type=str, default="gpt2")
    parser.add_argument("--max-length", type=int, default=768)
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=float, default=3.0)
    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=5e-5)
    parser.add_argument("--train-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--gradient-accumulation-steps", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--weight-decay", type=float, default=0.01)
    parser.add_argument("--warmup-ratio", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument("--logging-steps", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--save-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    train_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "train_sft.jsonl")
    val_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "val_sft.jsonl")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    train_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(train_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    val_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(val_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    collator = PromptCompletionCollator(tokenizer)

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    model.config.pad_token_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    device_flags = resolve_device_flags()

    training_args = TrainingArguments(
        output_dir=str(args.output_dir),
        num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
        learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
        per_device_train_batch_size=args.train_batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.eval_batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        weight_decay=args.weight_decay,
        warmup_ratio=args.warmup_ratio,
        logging_steps=args.logging_steps,
        save_steps=args.save_steps,
        eval_steps=args.eval_steps,
        eval_strategy="steps",
        save_strategy="steps",
        load_best_model_at_end=True,
        metric_for_best_model="eval_loss",
        greater_is_better=False,
        remove_unused_columns=False,
        report_to=[],
        seed=args.seed,
        fp16=device_flags["fp16"],
        bf16=device_flags["bf16"],
    )

    trainer = Trainer(
        model=model,
        args=training_args,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=val_dataset,
        data_collator=collator,
    )

    trainer.train()
    trainer.save_model(args.output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)

    metadata = {
        "model_name": args.model_name,
        "max_length": args.max_length,
        "epochs": args.epochs,
        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
        "gradient_accumulation_steps": args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        "train_examples": len(train_dataset),
        "val_examples": len(val_dataset),
    }
    (args.output_dir / "training_metadata.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Fine-tune GPT-2 for synthetic refactoring + repair tasks.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-name", type=str, default="gpt2")
    parser.add_argument("--max-length", type=int, default=768)
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=float, default=3.0)
    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=5e-5)
    parser.add_argument("--train-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--gradient-accumulation-steps", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--weight-decay", type=float, default=0.01)
    parser.add_argument("--warmup-ratio", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument("--logging-steps", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--save-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    train_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "train_sft.jsonl")
    val_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "val_sft.jsonl")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    train_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(train_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    val_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(val_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    collator = PromptCompletionCollator(tokenizer)

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    model.config.pad_token_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    device_flags = resolve_device_flags()

    training_args = TrainingArguments(
        output_dir=str(args.output_dir),
        num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
        learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
        per_device_train_batch_size=args.train_batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.eval_batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        weight_decay=args.weight_decay,
        warmup_ratio=args.warmup_ratio,
        logging_steps=args.logging_steps,
        save_steps=args.save_steps,
        eval_steps=args.eval_steps,
        eval_strategy="steps",
        save_strategy="steps",
        load_best_model_at_end=True,
        metric_for_best_model="eval_loss",
        greater_is_better=False,
        remove_unused_columns=False,
        report_to=[],
        seed=args.seed,
        fp16=device_flags["fp16"],
        bf16=device_flags["bf16"],
    )

    trainer = Trainer(
        model=model,
        args=training_args,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=val_dataset,
        data_collator=collator,
    )

    trainer.train()
    trainer.save_model(args.output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)

    metadata = {
        "model_name": args.model_name,
        "max_length": args.max_length,
        "epochs": args.epochs,
        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
        "gradient_accumulation_steps": args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        "train_examples": len(train_dataset),
        "val_examples": len(val_dataset),
    }
    (args.output_dir / "training_metadata.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)

    train_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "train_sft.jsonl")
    val_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "val_sft.jsonl")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    train_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(train_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    val_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(val_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    collator = PromptCompletionCollator(tokenizer)

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    model.config.pad_token_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    device_flags = resolve_device_flags()

    training_args = TrainingArguments(
        output_dir=str(args.output_dir),
        num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
        learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
        per_device_train_batch_size=args.train_batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.eval_batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        weight_decay=args.weight_decay,
        warmup_ratio=args.warmup_ratio,
        logging_steps=args.logging_steps,
        save_steps=args.save_steps,
        eval_steps=args.eval_steps,
        eval_strategy="steps",
        save_strategy="steps",
        load_best_model_at_end=True,
        metric_for_best_model="eval_loss",
        greater_is_better=False,
        remove_unused_columns=False,
        report_to=[],
        seed=args.seed,
        fp16=device_flags["fp16"],
        bf16=device_flags["bf16"],
    )

    trainer = Trainer(
        model=model,
        args=training_args,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=val_dataset,
        data_collator=collator,
    )

    trainer.train()
    trainer.save_model(args.output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)

    metadata = {
        "model_name": args.model_name,
        "max_length": args.max_length,
        "epochs": args.epochs,
        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
        "gradient_accumulation_steps": args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        "train_examples": len(train_dataset),
        "val_examples": len(val_dataset),
    }
    (args.output_dir / "training_metadata.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Fine-tune GPT-2 for synthetic refactoring + repair tasks.")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model-name", type=str, default="gpt2")
    parser.add_argument("--max-length", type=int, default=768)
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=float, default=3.0)
    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=5e-5)
    parser.add_argument("--train-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--gradient-accumulation-steps", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--weight-decay", type=float, default=0.01)
    parser.add_argument("--warmup-ratio", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument("--logging-steps", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--save-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    train_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "train_sft.jsonl")
    val_rows = load_jsonl(args.benchmark_dir / "val_sft.jsonl")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    train_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(train_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    val_dataset = PromptCompletionDataset(val_rows, tokenizer, args.max_length)
    collator = PromptCompletionCollator(tokenizer)

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    model.config.pad_token_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    device_flags = resolve_device_flags()

    training_args = TrainingArguments(
        output_dir=str(args.output_dir),
        num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
        learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
        per_device_train_batch_size=args.train_batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.eval_batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        weight_decay=args.weight_decay,
        warmup_ratio=args.warmup_ratio,
        logging_steps=args.logging_steps,
        save_steps=args.save_steps,
        eval_steps=args.eval_steps,
        eval_strategy="steps",
        save_strategy="steps",
        load_best_model_at_end=True,
        metric_for_best_model="eval_loss",
        greater_is_better=False,
        remove_unused_columns=False,
        report_to=[],
        seed=args.seed,
        fp16=device_flags["fp16"],
        bf16=device_flags["bf16"],
    )

    trainer = Trainer(
        model=model,
        args=training_args,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=val_dataset,
        data_collator=collator,
    )

    trainer.train()
    trainer.save_model(args.output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)

    metadata = {
        "model_name": args.model_name,
        "max_length": args.max_length,
        "epochs": args.epochs,
        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
        "gradient_accumulation_steps": args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
        "train_examples": len(train_dataset),
        "val_examples": len(val_dataset),
    }
    (args.output_dir / "training_metadata.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
